title: modify sizes_custom/strides_custom to work w/out pyobj_interpreter
body: `sizes_custom` and `strides_custom` use the Python interpreter to handle symints since these functions require an IntArrayRef return type. for c++ faketensor this no longer works because we hit this before we cross the c++/python boundary so there is no pyobj interpreter. instead, we call guard_int() directly to record and save concrete integers, which are then recomputed if they change. we store this on symbolicshape meta which is on ExtraMeta to avoid overhead. ownership is still tied to tensor.

items.author: ezyang
items.body: @claude this sounds right, just needs to be carefully reviewed
